modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Turn the parts of Olivares this installation runs on or off. Apply restarts the engine once to take the change, and the restart stops the running sessions.

restartWarning.title: Restart the engine?
restartWarning.stop_one: {{count}} running session stops. It can be resumed after the restart.
restartWarning.stop_other: {{count}} running sessions stop. Each one can be resumed after the restart.
restartWarning.unknown: Every running session stops. Each one can be resumed after the restart.
